segments.ja473:1.1: Kāni kammāni kubbānaṃ, kathaṃ viññū parakkame;
segments.ja473:1.3: Amittaṃ jāneyya medhāvī, disvā sutvā ca paṇḍito.
segments.ja473:2.1: Na naṃ umhayate disvā, na ca naṃ paṭinandati;
segments.ja473:2.3: Cakkhūni cassa [cakkhūnissa (syā. ka.)] na dadāti, paṭilomañca vattati.
segments.ja473:3.1: Amitte tassa bhajati, mitte tassa na sevati;
segments.ja473:4.1: Guyhañca tassa nakkhāti, tassa guyhaṃ na gūhati;
segments.ja473:4.3: Kammaṃ tassa na vaṇṇeti, paññassa nappasaṃsati.
segments.ja473:5.1: Abhave nandati tassa, bhave tassa na nandati;
segments.ja473:5.3: Accheraṃ [acchariyaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] bhojanaṃ laddhā, tassa nuppajjate sati;
segments.ja473:5.5: Tato naṃ nānukampati, aho sopi [ahāsopi (ka. sī. syā. ka.)] labheyyito.
segments.ja473:6.3: Yehi amittaṃ jāneyya, disvā sutvā ca paṇḍito.
segments.ja473:7.1: Kāni kammāni kubbānaṃ, kathaṃ viññū parakkame;
segments.ja473:7.3: Mittaṃ jāneyya medhāvī, disvā sutvā ca paṇḍito.
segments.ja473:9.1: Mitte tasseva bhajati, amitte tassa na sevati;
segments.ja473:10.1: Guyhañca tassa akkhāti, tassa guyhañca gūhati;
segments.ja473:10.3: Kammañca tassa vaṇṇeti, paññaṃ tassa [paññamassa (syā. ka.)] pasaṃsati.
segments.ja473:11.1: Bhave ca nandati tassa [bhave nandati tassa ca (ka.)], abhave tassa na nandati;
segments.ja473:11.3: Accheraṃ [acchariyaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] bhojanaṃ laddhā, tassa uppajjate sati;
segments.ja473:11.5: Tato naṃ anukampati, aho sopi [pahāsopi (ka. sī. syā. ka.)] labheyyito.
segments.ja473:12.3: Yehi mittañca jāneyya [mittaṃ sujāneyya (pī. ka.)], disvā sutvā ca paṇḍitoti.
segments.ja473:16.1: Lahucitta sasāla kasanti puna, atha kāma dasakhaluṭṭhānavaro;
segments.ja473:16.3: Atha kaṇha sukosiya meṇḍavaro, padumo puna mittavarena dasāti.

lines: Tattha na naṃ umhayate disvāti taṃ mittaṃ mittapatirūpako disvā sitaṃ na karoti, pahaṭṭhākāraṃ na dasseti.
Na ca naṃ paṭinandatīti tassa kathaṃ paggaṇhanto na paṭinandati na tussati.
Cakkhūni cassa na dadātīti olokentaṃ na oloketi.
Paññassāti assa paññaṃ nappasaṃsati, ñāṇasampadaṃ na pasaṃsati.
Tassa nuppajjate satīti tassa mittapatirūpakassa “mama mittassapi ito dassāmī”ti sati na uppajjati.
Kelāyitoti kelāyati mamāyati pattheti piheti icchatīti attho.
Rājā mahāsattassa kathāya attamano hutvā tassa mahantaṃ yasaṃ adāsi.
